messages:
elaine: Quick check — I'm planning a small change to the autoscaling config for api-prod to reduce OOM/burst failures during spikes. Posting the plan and snippets, please eyeball for regressions or missing RBAC/secrets wiring.

elaine: TL;DR: change HPA to use custom request-per-second metric + increase minReplicas, set VPA to "auto for requests/limits" disabled (we'll rely on autoscaling + safer resource requests), tweak Karpenter provisioner TTL and consolidation to avoid node churn, and update metrics-adapter secret path.

elaine: Current HPA (old):
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api-prod-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: api-prod
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 12
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
```

elaine: Proposed HPA (snippet):
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api-prod-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: api-prod
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: requests_per_second
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "15" # target ~15 rps per pod
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 20
        periodSeconds: 60
```

elaine: Karpenter provisioner TF snippet (plan):
```hcl
resource "aws_karpenter_provisioner" "prod" {
  ttl_seconds_until_expired = 600
  consolidation = true
  requirements = ["instance-type != t3.micro"]
  limits { cpu = "5000" }
}
```

elaine: Also moving metrics-adapter secret from secret path `infra/metrics/api` -> `infra/metrics/api-prod` to keep staging/prod separate. Make sure SA for metrics-adapter (metrics-reader@api-prod) has namespaced access.

akshay: Quick Q — why move to pods/requests_per_second vs CPU? Are the request patterns CPU-agnostic?

elaine: akshay: We saw repeated OOMs from cold-started pods where CPU was fine but per-pod request queueing caused memory pressure. rps-based is closer to app-level load here. CPU target still useful as fallback but we keep primary metric as rps.

devon: Leave a note to add a PodDisruptionBudget and increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds for the deployment. Otherwise consolidation + scale-down can drop pods mid-request.

elaine: good call. Will add PDB: minAvailable: 70% and set terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120 for api container.

sam: pls run a 30m soak in staging with the new HPA and a 2x synthetic spike. ping me when PR is up. Also check node eviction timeout vs Karpenter draining defaults.

elaine: noted. PR link once I open — will include a canary rollout strategy (50% traffic for 10m) then 100% if no errors.

devon: One more: ensure metrics adapter RBACs updated in TF. We had a subtle bug last time where the adapter SA lost access to custom metrics API after secret path rename.

elaine: Will add a terraform plan target and run in staging: `terraform plan -target=module.metrics -target=module.karpenter`. I'll paste plan output in this thread.

infra-bot: CI check passed for infra/metrics module (sha: 3a7b2f7) :white_check_mark:

akshay: LGTM from me on the HPA semantics. Keep an eye on latency p95 during scale events.

elaine: Thanks all — I'll open the PR and tag @sam and @devon for the staging soak. If anyone spots missing RBAC or a TF drift risk, mention it here before I land. :thumbsup:
